meta.title: Auction strategy cannot be changed after the event goes live

steps.note: Open the existing published live auction event from the live events list.

args.goal: On the live auction event, attempt to open the auction strategy configuration and change the strategy; verify on screen that the strategy cannot be updated while the event is live and that the original strategy remains in effect.

steps.note: No dedicated catalog step exposes live auction strategy editing, so perform the buyer-side attempt and verify the refusal and unchanged strategy directly on screen.
Confirm the live event remains stable with no error or crash after the blocked strategy-change attempt.
